aboutStatement: I'm Nihaal, an AI-integrated product designer based in London. My work is multidisciplinary: UI/UX, graphic design, branding, motion and 3D, from research and wireframes through to working prototypes and the visual story that launches them. I use AI to prototype faster, and design it into products where it genuinely helps the people using them.
